name: Marketing agency hero: split editorial hero, headline's last word cycles through four outcomes on a pure-CSS relay
notes: Pure CSS relay, no JS. Four .cycle-word spans are absolutely stacked inside a fixed-height .cycle wrapper; each runs the same 9.6s cycleWord keyframe but with animation-delay staggered by 2.4s (9.6s / 4 words), so only one word is ever visible at a time in a continuous hand-off loop. To add/remove a word: change both the delay stagger (cycle-duration / word-count) on the nth-child selectors AND the keyframe's percentages stay the same since they're relative to each word's own delayed timeline, not the total word count — only the delay math needs to change. Reduced-motion fallback hides every word but the first and kills the animation, so it reads as a normal static headline rather than four overlapping words. Swap portrait-lifestyle.jpg for the target site's actual founder/team photo — the rounded 'Since 2016' badge pairs best with a personal, founder-led positioning; drop it if the target brand doesn't lead with a specific date.
